data.title: Abnormally High Refund Rate Per Customer Account
data.description: Detects customer accounts with an abnormally high refund-to-order ratio over a rolling window. Accounts exceeding a refund rate of 40% across 10 or more orders within 90 days are flagged as potential refund abusers or participants in refunding-as-a-service (RaaS) schemes, where professional refunders exploit return policies systematically.

aggregation.condition:
selection
| groupby(customer_account_id)
| where count(event_type='refund_issued') / count(event_type='order_completed') > 0.4
| where count(event_type='order_completed') >= 10

falsepositives: Customers with legitimate sizing issues making frequent clothing returns
Product quality issues causing high return rates for specific SKUs across multiple customers
